40022154.author: पदार्थः
40022154.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, च and, काकुत्स्थम् to Kakutstha (Rama), प्रशस्य having praised, च and, पुनः पुनः again and again, पुनरेव again indeed, अपरम् another, वाक्यम् word/statement, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus (Rama).

40022154.author: Translation
40022154.content: Having spoken thus to Rama and praised him repeatedly, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, then spoke another statement.

40022155.author: पदार्थः
40022155.content: इमानि these, अश्वसहस्राणि thousands of horses, चत्वारि four, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, रथानाम् of chariots, द्वे two, सहस्रे thousands, च and, गजानाम् of elephants, शतम् a hundred, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022155.author: Translation
40022155.content: O best among men, take these four thousand horses, two thousand chariots, and a hundred excellent elephants.

40022156.author: पदार्थः
40022156.content: अन्तरा in between, पणवीथ्यः market streets, च and, नानापण्योपशोभिताः adorned with various goods, अनुगच्छन्तु let them follow, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha, तथैव similarly, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers.

40022156.author: Translation
40022156.content: Let market streets adorned with various goods, and similarly actors and dancers, follow Kakutstha along the way.

40022157.author: पदार्थः
40022157.content: हिरण्यस्य of gold, सुवर्णस्य of fine gold, नियुतम् a million, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, आदाय taking, गच्छ go, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, पर्याप्तधनवाहनः having sufficient wealth and conveyances.

40022157.author: Translation
40022157.content: O Shatrughna, best among men, take a million units of gold and fine gold, and go, equipped with ample wealth and conveyances.

40022158.author: पदार्थः
40022158.content: बलम् army, च and, सुभृतम् well-maintained, वीर O hero, हृष्टपुष्टम् cheerful and well-nourished, अनुद्धतम् disciplined, सम्भाषासम्प्रदानेन by good conversation and giving gifts, रञ्जयस्व please, नगेत्तम O best among men.

40022158.author: Translation
40022158.content: O hero, O best among men, please the well-maintained, cheerful, well-nourished, and disciplined army by engaging in good conversation and bestowing gifts.

40022159.author: पदार्थः
40022159.content: न not, हि indeed, अर्थाः wealth, तत्र there, तिष्ठन्ति remain, न nor, दाराः wives, न nor, च and, बान्धवाः relatives, सुप्रीतः well-pleased, भृत्यवर्गः servant class, च and, यत्र where, तिष्ठसि you stand, राघव O Raghava.

40022159.author: Translation
40022159.content: O Raghava, neither wealth, wives, nor relatives truly endure, but a well-pleased retinue will remain with you wherever you are.

40022160.author: पदार्थः
40022160.content: ततो then, हृष्टजनाकीर्णां filled with joyful people, प्रस्थाप्य having dispatched, महतीं a great, चमूम् army, एक alone, एव indeed, धनुष्पाणिः holding a bow in hand, गच्छ go, त्वं you, मधुनो of Madhu, वनम् to the forest.

40022160.author: Translation
40022160.content: Then, having dispatched a great army filled with joyful people, you alone, holding a bow in hand, should go to the forest of Madhu.

40022161.author: पदार्थः
40022161.content: यथा so that, त्वां you, न not, प्रजानाति knows, गच्छन्तं going, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणम् desiring battle, लवणस्तु but Lavana, मधोः of Madhu, पुत्रः the son, तथा thus, गच्छेः you should go, अशङ्कितम् without suspicion.

40022161.author: Translation
40022161.content: You should go without suspicion, so that Lavana, the son of Madhu, does not recognize you as one going and desiring battle.

40022162.author: पदार्थः
40022162.content: न not, तस्य his, मृत्युः death, अन्यः another, अस्ति is, कश्चित् any, हि indeed, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, दर्शनं sight, यः who, अभिगच्छेत approaches, सः he, वध्यः to be killed, लवणेन by Lavana, हि indeed.

40022162.author: Translation
40022162.content: O best among men, there is no other way to kill him, for anyone who approaches his sight is indeed slain by Lavana.

40022163.author: पदार्थः
40022163.content: सः that, हि indeed, ग्रीष्मः summer, अपयाते having departed, तु but, वर्षारात्रे when the rainy season, उपागते has arrived, हन्याः you should kill, त्वं you, लवणं Lavana, सौम्य O gentle one, सः that, हि indeed, कालः time, अस्य for him, दुर्मतेः the wicked one.

40022163.author: Translation
40022163.content: O gentle one, you should kill Lavana when summer has departed and the rainy season has arrived, for that is indeed the opportune time for that wicked one.

40022164.author: पदार्थः
40022164.content: महर्षींस्तु but the great sages, पुरत्कृत्य having placed in front, प्रयान्तु let them go, तव your, सौनिकाः soldiers, यथा so that, ग्रीष्मावशेषेण with the remaining part of summer, तरेयुः they may cross, जाह्नवीजलम् the waters of the Ganga.

40022164.author: Translation
40022164.content: Let your soldiers proceed, placing the great sages in front, so that they may cross the waters of the Ganga with the remaining part of summer.

40022165.author: पदार्थः
40022165.content: तत्र there, स्थाप्य having stationed, बलं army, सर्वं all, नदीतीरे on the river bank, समाहितः having settled, अग्रतः in front, धनुषा with the bow, सार्धं together with, गच्छ go, त्वं you, लघुविक्रमः swift in action.

40022165.author: Translation
40022165.content: Having stationed your entire army on the river bank, you, swift in action, should proceed ahead with your bow.

40022166.author: पदार्थः
40022166.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, रामेण by Rama, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तान् those, महाबलान् mighty, सेनामुख्यान् army chiefs, समानीय having gathered, ततः then, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022166.author: Translation
40022166.content: Thus addressed by Rama, Shatrughna gathered those mighty army chiefs and then spoke these words.

40022167.author: पदार्थः
40022167.content: एते these, वः your, गणिताः assigned, वासाः camps, यत्र where, तत्र there, निवत्स्यथ you shall dwell, स्थातव्यं one should stay, च and, अविरोधेन peacefully, यथा so that, बाधा trouble, न not, कस्यचित् to anyone.

40022167.author: Translation
40022167.content: These are your assigned camps where you shall dwell, and you must stay peacefully so that no one is troubled.

40022168.author: पदार्थः
40022168.content: तथा thus, तान् them, तु indeed, समाज्ञाप्य having instructed, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, च and, महत् great, बलम् army, कौसल्यां Kausalya, च and, सुमित्रां Sumitra, च and, कैकेयीं Kaikeyi, च and, अभ्यवादयत् he saluted.

40022168.author: Translation
40022168.content: Having thus instructed them and sent forth the great army, he then saluted Kausalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi.

40022169.author: पदार्थः
40022169.content: रामं Rama, प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य having circumambulated, शिरसा with his head, अभिप्रणम्य having bowed down, च and, रामेण by Rama, च and, अभ्यनुज्ञातः permitted, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, शत्रुतापनः tormentor of enemies.

40022169.author: Translation
40022169.content: Having circumambulated Rama and bowed down with his head, Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies, was then given leave by Rama.

40022170.author: पदार्थः
40022170.content: लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, भरतं Bharata, चैव and also, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, पुरोहितं to the priest, वसिष्ठं Vasishtha, च and, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, प्रयतात्मवान् with a controlled mind, प्रदक्षिणमथो then circumambulation, कृत्वा having done, निर्जगाम departed, महाबलः the mighty one.

40022170.author: Translation
40022170.content: The mighty and pure-minded Shatrughna, having bowed down with folded hands to Lakshmana, Bharata, and the priest Vasishtha, and having performed circumambulation, then departed.

40022171.author: पदार्थः
40022171.content: प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, सेनाम् the army, अथ then, सः he, अग्रतः in front, तदा then, गजेन्द्रवाजिप्रवरौघसङ्कुलाम् crowded with excellent elephants and horses, उपास stayed, मासं for a month, तु indeed, नरेन्द्रपार्श्वतः by the king's side, त्वथ then, प्रयातः departed, रघुवंशवर्धनः the增ifier of the Raghu dynasty.

40022171.author: Translation
40022171.content: Having first sent forth his army, which was crowded with excellent elephants and horses, Shatrughna, the增ifier of the Raghu dynasty, then stayed by the king's side for a month before departing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 64 ।। Thus ends the sixty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
